scope: Remove rebuildable resources unrelated to paper writing while preserving all paper evidence and the active P8 benchmark.

intermediate_epoch_checkpoints.reason: Not referenced by paper analysis; project handoff states these snapshots do not provide verified lossless resume.

preserved_evidence: all training CSV and per-head logs
all resolved configs, provenance, summaries, split indices and manifests
all official/external access records and negative/failed/interrupted evidence
all P5-A/B and P5-C logits, tables and figures
recovery: Removed files were deleted directly and are not recoverable from this server. They can be regenerated only by rerunning training; retained best/latest/final checkpoints and logs remain sufficient for the registered paper analyses.
